blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Thursday challenged Vice President Sara Duterte to answer the allegations against her instead of making up stories after her camp claimed there were talks to possibly cancel the 2028 national elections. Duterte’s spokesperson Paolo Panelo earlier shared in an interview at The Spokes program that the vice president told him about a possible “no-el” (no elections) in 2028 based on the information she received.
